# Drey Studio

Drey Studio is a website development and digital design studio led by Damilare Olaniyi. It helps businesses turn ideas and business goals into useful digital experiences through website development, UI/UX design, SEO and digital design.

## Key pages and features

- [Home](https://www.dreystudio.ng/): Overview of Drey Studio's services, work, process and frequently asked questions.
- [About](https://www.dreystudio.ng/about): Studio background, founder information, services and working approach.
- [Services](https://www.dreystudio.ng/service/service): Overview of the studio's service offering.
- [Website Development](https://www.dreystudio.ng/service/website-development): Business websites, landing pages, e-commerce websites, custom web applications and redesigns.
- [UI/UX Design](https://www.dreystudio.ng/service/ui-ux-design): User interface and experience design focused on clarity and usability.
- [SEO & AI Search Optimization](https://www.dreystudio.ng/service/seo-ai-search-optimization): Search visibility, technical SEO, on-page optimization, local SEO and AI search optimization.
- [Graphic Design](https://www.dreystudio.ng/service/graphic-design): Brand and visual design work for digital touchpoints.
- [Work](https://www.dreystudio.ng/work): Selected project work.
- [Pricing](https://www.dreystudio.ng/pricing): Pricing information.
- [Blog](https://www.dreystudio.ng/blog/): Articles about websites, web design, SEO and related digital topics.
- [Book a consultation](https://www.dreystudio.ng/book-consultation): Consultation booking page.
